prompt: I just got good news: I'm going to be a dad!
completion:
Congratulations! 🎉 That’s absolutely wonderful news—what an exciting milestone to look forward to.  

A few quick thoughts to get you into the groove (and if you’d like, feel free to ask about anything else, from baby gear to first‑month milestones!):

| Topic | Quick Tip / Fun Fact |
|-------|----------------------|
| **Due Date** | If you’re not sure, a simple Google “what’s my due date calculator” can help you estimate it from your last period or ultrasound. |
| **Baby’s Gender** | If it’s a surprise, consider the “when‑the‑baby‑arrives” countdown—no pressure, just fun anticipation. |
| **Dad‑Style** | Whether you’re a “hands‑on” type, the “brain‑dad” (always ready with trivia), or the “sleep‑trainer,” you’re already the best dad just by caring. |
| **Prep List** | Think about the basics: diaper bag, sleep‑positioning aids, and a reliable stroller. You might want to check out a quick “first‑time dad” checklist on BabyCenter or what‑to‑buy-for-your‑baby. |
| **Health & Wellness** | Prenatal vitamins are a must, and keep an eye on your own nutrition and exercise routine—your body and your baby will thank you! |
| **Bonding** | Even in the third trimester, you can start bonding by talking to the baby, singing, or holding the mother during her ultrasound visits. |

Feel free to share your due date, any questions you have about the next few months, or just tell me how you’re feeling about becoming a dad. I’m here to help with info, ideas, or a listening ear! 🍼👶
